mapper.select: select connect_date connectDate from connect_count where connect_date = curdate() and member_role= #{memberRole}
mapper.insert: insert into connect_count(connect_date, member_role, count) values(curdate(),#{memberRole}, 1)
mapper.update: update connect_count set count= count+1 where connect_date=curdate() and member_role=#{memberRole}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN member_role = 'ANONYMOUS' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS ANONYMOUS, SUM(CASE WHEN member_role = 'MEMBER' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS MEMBER, SUM(CASE WHEN member_role = 'ADMIN' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS ADMIN FROM connect_count
